title: Senior IT Engineer
locationText: Germany (Remote) ; Ireland (Remote); Netherlands (Remote) ; Portugal (Remote) ; United Kingdom (Remote)  | United Kingdom (Remote)
description:
Who we are
Typeform is a refreshingly different form builder. We help over 150,000 businesses collect the data they need with forms, surveys, and quizzes that people enjoy. Designed to look striking and feel effortless to fill out, Typeform drives 500 million responses every year—and integrates with essential tools like Slack, Zapier, and Hubspot.
About the role
At Typeform, we believe technology should make work simpler, smarter and more human.
We're looking for a Senior IT Engineer to help shape the future of IT at Typeform. Someone who combines strong technical expertise with a passion for automation, AI and building better ways of working.
This isn't just about keeping systems running. It's about rethinking how IT operates.
You'll play a key role in building an AI first, service led IT function, improving how we manage internal technology, support our people and automate everyday processes.
Working within a small, high impact team, you'll have the opportunity to take ownership of meaningful projects, influence our technology roadmap and help us move from reactive support towards smarter, more proactive IT operations.
What you'll do
Own and improve our IT operations
• Act as a senior escalation point for complex IT incidents, requests and technical challenges, taking ownership through to resolution.
• Help maintain secure, reliable and scalable internal technology systems.
• Apply ITIL best practices across incident, change, problem and service management.
• Improve service performance, documentation, operational processes and the overall employee experience.
• Work closely with the wider IT team to balance daily support with longer term engineering projects.
Build smarter systems through AI and automation
• Identify opportunities to automate repetitive tasks and improve workflows across IT.
• Design and implement AI powered solutions that improve service delivery, productivity and operational efficiency.
• Improve employee onboarding, offboarding, access management and software lifecycle processes.
• Use APIs, integrations, scripting and automation tools to connect systems and remove unnecessary manual work.
• Explore emerging AI technologies and turn promising ideas into practical solutions, with appropriate security and governance.
Think like a product owner
• Take ownership of specific IT services and capabilities, from identifying problems through to delivering improvements.
• Work with stakeholders to understand their needs and prioritise improvements based on business impact.
• Build and maintain clear roadmaps and project backlogs.
• Measure the success of improvements through service quality, efficiency, reliability and employee experience.
• Lead technical changes, migrations and improvements with clear communication, risk management and planning.
Collaborate across Typeform
• Partner with Security, People, Finance, Procurement and Engineering to deliver secure and effective technology solutions.
• Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and nontechnical colleagues.
• Share knowledge, improve documentation and support the development of other IT team members.
• Help create a culture of ownership, continuous improvement and experimentation.
What you'll bring
• Strong experience in corporate IT engineering, systems engineering or IT service management within a modern SaaS or technology company.
• ITIL certification and practical experience applying ITIL principles across incident, change, problem and service management.
• Proven experience troubleshooting complex issues across corporate IT systems, identity, access, devices, applications and integrations.
• Strong hands on experience with modern IT environments, particularly Apple devices, Okta, Google Workspace, Slack and Atlassian.
• Experience building automation using APIs, scripting, integrations or workflow automation tools.
• Practical experience using AI to improve IT operations, support processes or internal productivity.
• Experience improving employee lifecycle processes, including onboarding, offboarding, provisioning and access management.
• Strong problem solving skills and the ability to take ownership of technical challenges from investigation through to resolution.
• A product mindset, with experience prioritising improvements, managing stakeholders and delivering measurable outcomes.
• Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively across technical and business teams.
Nice to have
• Experience designing AI driven IT workflows or introducing AI into internal service operations.
• Familiarity with AI agents, intelligent workflow orchestration and knowledge management systems.
• Experience integrating HR, identity, finance, asset management and IT service platforms.
• Experience building internal tooling, dashboards or operational reporting.
• Exposure to security, compliance, endpoint management and IT governance.
• Experience leading technology migrations or large internal systems improvement projects.
*Typeform drives hundreds of millions of interactions each year, enabling conversational, human-centered experiences across the globe. We move as one team , empowering our collective efforts by valuing each individual’s unique perspective. This fosters strong bonds grounded in respect, transparency, and trust. We champion our diverse customer base by anticipating their needs and addressing their challenges with priority. Committed to excellence, we hold high expectations for ourselves and each other, continuously striving to deliver exceptional results.
We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and stand firmly against discrimination and harassment of any kind—whether based on race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. Everyone is welcome here.

Powered by a best-in-class telecom platform, proprietary eSIM technology, and its own mobile core network across 15 countries, 1GLOBAL operates as a fully regulated telecommunications provider in 43 countries.
Founded in 2022, 1GLOBAL has rapidly become one of Europe's fastest-growing telecom technology companies, connecting more than 80 million people and devices globally. Our customers include leading banks, multinational enterprises, global retailers, travel companies, payment service providers, and digital-first businesses.
Headquartered in the Netherlands, with R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 550 professionals across 16 countries. title: Principal Forward Deployed Engineer
locationText: England | Portugal | Spain | Italy | Germany | United Kingdom
description:
ABOUT DOCKER

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________



Docker Forward Deployed Engineers (FDE) embed directly with our most strategic customers to solve important, complex technical problems and turn ambitious ideas into production outcomes. FDEs take on the most challenging technical challenges using existing Docker products and patterns when possible, and work across customer, Docker Product and Engineering teams to realize new approaches when required.

 

As a Docker FDE, you will work side-by-side with customer engineering teams to deeply understand their goals, problems, constraints, and technical landscape; identify the highest-leverage opportunities; and design, build, and ship solutions with them. You own the technical journey from discovery and architecture through prototyping, implementation and production rollout.

 

The solutions you build may use existing Docker products, extend Docker into new environments, integrate deeply with customer and third-party systems, or reveal capabilities that Docker should build next. You work closely with Docker Solutions Architects to evolve existing patterns, and Docker Product and Engineering to turn new learnings into reusable patterns and product capabilities.

 


RESPONSIBILITIES

Build in Production with Customers

 - Embed with customer engineering teams to design, build, and ship solutions from first prototype through stable production rollout. Use existing Docker products and patterns when possible, invent, prototype and validate innovative solutions when necessary.

 - Deliver working technical artifacts to customers: custom MCP servers with tightly integrated Docker Sandbox environments for coding agents and containerized agents; Docker Compose definitions for multi-agent harnesses and model-backed applications; Hardened Image standardization and migration; New tools that unblock customer progress.

 - Integrate Docker's AI platform with the customer's existing stack, including identity providers (OIDC/SAML/SSO), secrets management, private and air-gapped registries, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and observability tooling.

 - Own technical delivery on your engagements: scope the work, sequence it, make trade-offs between speed and quality, remove blockers early, and contribute directly to code whenever progress depends on it.

Make AI Adoption Safe and Governable

 - Translate customer security, compliance, and platform requirements into concrete plans and see those plans through from ideation to production.

 - Help customers define controls to enable them to adopt agentic AI to solve their unique business problems without compromising security, compliance, data sovereignty or end-user experience.

 - Establish quality and performance standards for customers and work closely with Docker Product and Engineering to quickly address issues that fall outside of established thresholds

 - Partner with customer security and platform teams to get agentic workloads through architecture review, threat modeling, and change control.

Partner with Solutions Architecture and the Field

 - Work closely with Solutions Architects to enable off-the-self solutions when possible and provide technical experience and leadership when a bespoke solution is necessary.

 - Feed implementation learnings back into reference architectures, SOW templates, and success patterns so that FDE innovations become standard features and implementation patterns.

 - Support the field with technical depth during proofs of concept, escalations, and expansion conversations when a working build is the fastest path to a customer adoption.

Close the Loop with Product and Engineering

 - As part of Docker Engineering FDEs work closely with Product and Engineering teams to fold FDE innovations, learnings, and design patterns into existing or new products and services.

 - Work with Customers, Product and Engineering to establish quality and performance thresholds, ensuring customer environments meet them consistently, and responding quickly and decisively when they don’t.

 - Be the voice of the customer. Deliver data-driven and actionable feedback to Product and Engineering: what works well; what does not; what customers are asking for; and what blocks their adoption and forward progress. FDE experience directly influences the roadmap.

Shape the Practice

 - Define the FDE engagement model, delivery standards, and quality bar, and codify them so that engagements are consistent across customers, regions, and delivery partners.

 - Mentor and lead other Forward Deployed Engineers, and participate in hiring loops to grow the team.

 - Act as the senior technical escalation point on the hardest problems impacting your customers. Every incident is an opportunity to improve Docker products and services.

 - Maintain deep, current knowledge of the agentic AI stack: LLMs, APIs, MCP, coding agents, model and harness evaluation approaches, performance and quality thresholds, deployment patterns.

 - This role may require participation in an on-call rotation to provide support outside of standard business hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, as needed.

 


QUALIFICATIONS

Testlio's fully managed crowdsourced testing platform, powered by our proprietary intelligence technology - LeoCore™, integrates expert, on-demand testers directly into your release process. We are hiring a Principal Architect to serve as a hands-on individual contributor who will shape our application and platform architecture, driving production-ready systems that directly enable our next generation of intelligent, distributed software testing solutions.
Why will you love this job?
• High Ownership and Autonomy: Be a foundational technical leader steering a profound platform transformation, making critical structural decisions that balance immediate system delivery with long-term enterprise scalability.
• Pragmatic AI & System Innovation: Step past the hype to integrate actionable AI capabilities directly into high-throughput surfaces, modernizing our core monolith into a robust distributed network alongside our product and executive leaders.
Why you will love being a part of Testlio?
• Great Culture : Testlio is a female-founded company, and half of our team identifies as women. We’re proud of our inclusive, purpose-driven culture where people genuinely enjoy collaborating. As part of our team (we call ourselves TestLions), you’ll help create exceptional digital experiences for our customers, while also contributing to our freelance network.
• Remote Work : Our culture is built around remote work. We’ve created systems to allow us to successfully work together asynchronously as a fully remote and globally distributed team . Testlio provides the tools and guidance for everyone to succeed in their careers in a fully remote setting. Our working style encourages everyone to make decisions, communicate effectively, and work at a sustainable pace.
• Investment in You : Your growth and well-being matter to us. You’ll have flexible paid time off—including national holidays, personal days, and sick days—plus stock options so you can grow with Testlio. We also provide a $300 annual learning stipend to support your personal and professional development.

• Author clear architectural standards and reference patterns that define domain boundaries, decoupling our current codebase into modular services.
• Partner with the Director of Engineering to execute frontend framework consolidation, improving operational performance and observability.
• Safeguard system efficiency and regulatory posture by designing with security, cost-efficiency, and ISO 27001 expectations at the center.
• Integrate secure AI/LLM patterns into customer-facing surfaces, establishing strict operational guardrails and failure modes for our Quality API.

What do you need to succeed?
Technical Skills
• 15+ years of hands-on software development experience building cloud-native, business-critical platforms.
• Advanced mastery of distributed system patterns, data modeling, event-driven design, and database technologies (Relational and NoSQL).
• Proven track record designing and migrating application infrastructures, specifically moving from monolithic architectures to modular services.
• Deep experience establishing enterprise-ready patterns in AWS, emphasizing high availability, cost optimization, and secure infrastructure.
• Strong familiarity with modern full-stack code environments, including front-end web frameworks, scripting languages, and CI/CD pipelines.
• Practical, production-grade experience deploying AI/ML or LLM-based solutions with an emphasis on observable, safe automation patterns.
Human Skills
• Fluency in English with exceptional written and verbal communication skills, especially when presenting advanced architecture concepts to business leaders.
• Ability to operate effectively as an individual contributor in fast-paced, ambiguous environments, showing proactive problem ownership.
• Strong collaboration and alignment focus, capable of guiding distributed engineering teams and technical peers without direct authority.
• Outstanding analytical thinking, balancing a broad long-term technology vision with practical, short-term implementation constraints.
• Natural inclination for remote-first work, successfully communicating and documenting technical decisions asynchronously across global time zones.
What is the application process?
At Testlio, we aim to hire individuals who are excited about their role, thrive in a fully remote environment, and have strong long-term potential with our team. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.



Following our $35 million Series B in May 2026, we are entering our next stage of growth. We are hiring an Engineering Manager to help scale our product development team, strengthen our technical foundations, and turn complex private-markets problems into reliable, intuitive solutions.

Your primary responsibilities will be ensuring our engineering output delivers tangible customer value, setting technical and architectural direction, and developing the people and team capacity needed to deliver sustainably. You will help shape the next stage of our engineering organisation, with a focus on Product Excellence, clear ownership, and sustainable engineering processes.




YOUR ROLE

 - You will be at the core of building the technology that powers bunch: secure, reliable infrastructure that makes private-market operations simpler and more efficient.

 - You will lead a team and have full accountability for delivering solutions that truly solve customer problems, connecting engineering decisions to product outcomes.

 - You will help us scale beyond our Series B by strengthening our architecture, growing our engineers, and building delivery practices that support long-term quality rather than short-term output alone.

You will:

 - Collaborate with Product Management: Actively participate in problem discovery and solution creation, using your technical expertise to shape pragmatic solutions alongside Product and Design.

 - Own capacity management and delivery: Take a proactive role in planning, make priorities and trade-offs explicit, and own your team's output from discovery through release and follow-up. Balance customer impact, delivery predictability, and engineering quality.

 - Drive collaboration across teams: Work closely with other engineering teams and cross-functional partners to manage dependencies and ensure smooth delivery of new features and improvements.

 - Manage our architecture and technical debt: Guide system design, scalability, performance, and maintainability within your team's domain and across shared systems. Make deliberate investment decisions that keep our platform ready for growth.

 - Develop sustainable engineering practices: Establish clear quality standards and practical ways of working that help the team deliver reliably without adding unnecessary process.

 - Support team growth: Coach engineers through regular feedback and development conversations. Ensure they understand the core problems we are solving and how their day-to-day work contributes to customer outcomes and their own growth plans.
   
   


ABOUT YOU

To excel as a member of the Product Development team, you should combine a passion for technology with an entrepreneurial mindset and strong problem-solving skills.

 - 3+ years' experience leading engineering teams, with a track record of developing engineers and taking accountability for delivery.

 - A collaborative approach, strong work ethic, and excellent written and verbal communication skills.

 - A product-focused mindset: you care about understanding customer problems and can partner with Product and Design to turn them into effective technical solutions.

 - Strong backend development experience with TypeScript or another strongly typed language.

 - Experience with SQL databases and Nest.js or similar web/dependency management frameworks, such as Spring Boot or ASP.NET core

 - A strong understanding of system design principles, scalability, and performance tuning, with sound judgment about architectural trade-offs and technical debt.

 - The ability to create structure in a growing organisation while keeping processes pragmatic and focused on outcomes.

 - Experience with private markets, fintech, highly regulated industries, or document processing is a plus.


OUR TECH STACK

 - Frontend & Backend: TypeScript on both the frontend (Svelte but moving to React) and the backend (Node.js with Nest.js)

 - Database: MySQL

 - Infrastructure: Kubernetes (K8S) on top of AWS
   
   


WORKPLACE & BENEFITS

 - Customizable benefits package (wellbeing, sport, mobility, food, and more)

 - 28 days of vacation, plus 2 company days and local public holidays

 - Remote setup with quarterly company meetings 

 - Work with a diverse team of 120+ bunchies from 40+ countries, with leaders who are best-in-class in their domains
   
   


HIRING PROCESS

 - First interview with the People team (30 min): get acquainted with the bunch and to understand if what we’re offering is what you’re searching for

 - Hiring Manager Interview (60 min): this conversation will cover product-focused culture and values, including collaboration, ownership, self-awareness, and quality standards.

 - Technical Interview (60 min): System Design technical conversation with two engineers, we will focus on collaborative problem-solving, starting with open-ended questions and progressing to more specific challenges

 - Leadership Case Interview (60 min): this interview with Product and Design focuses on leadership style, cross-functional collaboration, and delivering strategic impact in a scaling environment.

 - Final Round: Meet our VP of Engineering and VP of Product (60 min) to learn about ways of working, vision for bunch, and team culture.

 - Meet-and-Greet (Optional - 30 min) to meet a few members of your future cross-functional team.

description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join an early-stage B2B SaaS company as a Senior Platform Software Engineer. You will own cloud infrastructure, deployment systems, and reliability for a high-traffic platform, helping the team make sound architecture decisions and ship with confidence.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Architect, deploy, and operate AWS infrastructure across compute, messaging, storage, networking, and observability.

 - Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines that automate deployments from commit through production.

 - Manage production PostgreSQL, including configuration, performance tuning, migrations, and backup strategies.

 - Balance delivery speed with investment in foundational system quality.

 - Work with stakeholders and product teams to shape architecture and technical direction.

 - Explore AI-assisted development tools and integrate them into build and deployment workflows.

 - Diagnose complex distributed-systems issues and deliver pragmatic solutions for high-availability services.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - At least 5 years of professional software engineering experience, including operating high-traffic, high-availability systems at scale.

 - Deep, hands-on experience running production infrastructure on AWS and managing infrastructure as code with Terraform or a similar tool.

 - Production PostgreSQL expertise, including connection pooling, migrations, performance optimization, and backup and restore.

 - Experience building or maintaining production CI/CD pipelines and working with distributed-systems concepts such as ordering guarantees, idempotency, retries, at-least-once delivery, and partial-failure recovery.

 - Ability to read and understand TypeScript and Node.js application code, including NestJS codebases.

 - Experience with AI-assisted development workflows, such as agentic coding tools, multi-agent setups, or MCP servers, alongside the independent technical judgment to debug and reason about architecture.

 - Strong problem-solving, communication, collaboration, and ownership skills.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Competitive salary and employee stock options. Visa sponsorship is not available.


LOCATION

Remote within Europe, with residence within three hours of Central European Time.
